q: How do we count emissions when goods are bartered instead of bought?
title: Bartered goods: how to count
short: Emissions follow the physical goods and services, not the payment. Count goods you receive as purchased goods by quantity, using a factor per kg or unit. Goods you give away were already counted when you made or bought them. A spend-based estimate needs a fair market value, so record one.
audience: Traders and businesses settling deals in kind

ul: Quantity and type from the delivery challan.
Supplier figure or a named factor per unit.
Category 1, or Category 2 if it is a capital item.

p: No new emissions are created by the swap; the goods' production stays where it was counted.

senseible: Senseible keeps purchase invoices on the Scope 3 trail with the category, method and factor source on every line, so spend-based estimates are labelled as estimates and can be replaced with supplier data later.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
